# Ahmed Shabab Noor

> Software Engineer III at Fin.com | Ex Data Engineer II at Pathao | Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh

Last updated: 2026-09-13

## About

Ahmed Shabab Noor is a Software Engineer specializing in scalable backend systems, data platforms, machine learning, and advanced analytics. AI-native engineer who builds fast across any domain. He currently works as Software Engineer III at Fin.com, a stablecoin-powered global payment infrastructure company. Previously, he was Data Engineer II at Pathao (Bangladesh's largest super-app), where he designed dynamic funnel analytics systems processing 500M+ data points, built a Bangla transliteration service increasing search coverage by 15x, and developed personalization algorithms reducing checkout navigation time by 32%. Expert in Go, Python, SQL, dbt, BigQuery, and cloud-native technologies.

He graduated Summa Cum Laude (CGPA 3.99/4.00) in Computer Science and Engineering from United International University with a 100% academic scholarship across 9 trimesters.

## Experience

### Software Engineer III - Fin.com (Dec 2025 - Present)
Stablecoin-powered global payment infrastructure company. Early engineer building core backend services from the ground up, primarily in Go, leveraging AI-driven development for rapid delivery. Built a double-entry bookkeeping ledger microservice serving as the core financial record-keeping system, with SHA-256 hash-chain balance integrity for a tamper-evident audit trail. Built a Role-Based Access Control system with a 3-tier role hierarchy and Redis-cached permission resolution, plus team management and a reverse proxy enforcing scope-based access control on API traffic. Built an internal API gateway for securely calling external financial APIs (payments, remittance, KYC) without sharing secrets, with per-user service ACLs, cryptographic request signing, and hot-reloadable Consul configuration. Designed a cross-currency fee calculation engine supporting bidirectional forward and reverse calculation against live FX rates. Integrated partners for virtual account provisioning and payout disbursement across USD, AED and EUR rails.

### Data Engineer II - Pathao (Jul 2024 - Dec 2025)
Designed dynamic funnel analytics system processing 500M+ data points. Built Bangla transliteration microservice increasing search coverage by 15x. Developed personalization algorithms reducing checkout navigation time by 32%. Designed A/B testing framework for data-driven product decisions. Built modular data models using dbt with optimized queries for cost savings.

### Data Engineer I - Pathao (Mar 2023 - Jun 2024)
Built ML models for ETA prediction in Dhaka and Chittagong, improving within-threshold rides from 20% to 60%. Developed address parsing service improving hub-level coverage by 10% and saving ~102K BDT/month. Built Bangla-to-English transliteration algorithm for address parsing. Redesigned Firebase user behavioral data pipeline processing 50-60M rows/day. Managed fraud detection systems for food vertical. Conducted A/B test analyses identifying ~$7K USD/month in potential savings. Optimized Redis storage reducing memory consumption by 72%.

### Data Engineering Intern - Pathao (Oct 2022 - Feb 2023)
Built CLI tools for data dictionary workflows. Developed first ML solution for ride pickup ETA prediction for Dhaka city. Researched data governance solutions. Worked on fraud detection using machine learning.

## Frequently Asked

**Who is Ahmed Shabab Noor?**
A software engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Currently Software Engineer III at Fin.com, building core backend services for stablecoin-powered payment infrastructure. Previously spent over three years at Pathao, Bangladesh's largest on-demand platform, moving from Data Engineering Intern to Data Engineer II.

**What does he work on at Fin.com?**
Core backend services for cross-border payments, primarily in Go: a double-entry bookkeeping ledger with SHA-256 hash-chain balance integrity, an RBAC system with Redis-cached permission resolution, an internal API gateway for calling vendor financial APIs without sharing secrets, and a cross-currency fee engine doing both forward and reverse calculation against live FX rates.

**What did he build at Pathao?**
Data and ML systems for a super-app: a dynamic funnel analytics system over 500M+ data points, a Bangla-to-English transliteration service that increased address search coverage 15x, personalization algorithms that cut checkout navigation time 32%, and ETA prediction models that raised within-threshold rides from 20% to 60%.

**What technologies does he work with?**
Primarily Go, Python and SQL. On the backend that means PostgreSQL, Redis, Consul, Docker and Kubernetes; on the data side, dbt, BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform.

**What has he published?**
Four peer-reviewed papers at IEEE and Springer conferences: attention-based scene graph generation, imbalanced data classification via label reassignment, diabetes prediction using transfer learning, and the impact of data locality on cluster-based under-sampling.

**Where did he study?**
United International University in Dhaka: BSc in Computer Science and Engineering, Summa Cum Laude, CGPA 3.99/4.00, on a full academic scholarship across nine trimesters. Before that, Notre Dame College, Dhaka.

**Is he open to new opportunities?**
Always open to interesting problems, collaborations, and good conversations.
